scripts.build: npm run build:pcb && npm run build:top-plate && npm run build:bottom-plate
scripts.build:pcb: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output pcb/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb export drill --output pcb/gerber/ --drill-origin absolute --excellon-units mm --excellon-zeros-format decimal pcb/tairakb.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output pcb/tairakb.pdf pcb/tairakb.kicad_sch
scripts.build:top-plate: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output plates/top/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output plates/top/taira-top-plate.pdf plates/top/taira-top-plate.kicad_sch
scripts.build:bottom-plate: kicad-cli pcb export gerbers --output plates/bottom/gerber/ --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,F.Mask,B.Mask,F.Paste,B.Paste,F.Silkscreen,B.Silkscreen,Edge.Cuts --no-x2 --subtract-soldermask plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli sch export pdf --output plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.pdf plates/bottom/taira-bottom-plate.kicad_sch
